Text: Masters of bio-engineering, the Splicetails have learned to weave sunlight into living wood. Their genetically modified trees drink in solar energy, powering their settlements without a single turning blade.
Without the Splicetails' careful tending, the spliced trees return to dormancy — and the colony fades with them.
Sunlight flows through every branch, and the Splicetails have achieved what nature never could alone.
A bio-engineered tree that converts sunlight directly into mechanical power. Unlike windmills it generates power in any weather.
The Splicetails found the wind unreliable. So they changed the trees instead.
A towering bio-engineered tree with an expanded canopy for maximum solar energy capture. Produces twice the power of a standard Spliced Grove.
Centuries of patience encoded in a single afternoon of splicing.
A bio-engineered tree that generates mechanical power when alive and mature. It must be kept watered to remain productive.
Not grown — engineered. Every cell in its trunk is a living solar converter, quietly turning light into motion.
Plants Spliced Trees in the surrounding area using Spliced Seeds. Spliced Trees generate mechanical power when mature and healthy.
Part workshop, part garden. The beavers here tend saplings with the same care others give to machines.
Assigns beavers to apply Mutagenic Serum to trees marked with the serum application tool. Mutated trees produce SplicedSeeds.
One drop of serum. One spliced tree. One kilowatt of hope.
Produces Mutagenic Serum from Badwater, and converts harvested seeds (PineCones, Acorns, Burrs) into SplicedSeeds for the Splice Nursery.
The process smells terrible. The results are remarkable.
Mark areas where Splicer workers will apply Mutagenic Serum to mutate trees.
Remove areas from the serum application zone.
A subterranean lodge housing 20 beavers. Built largely underground — the surface footprint can support crops and structures. Do not build over the entrance hatch.
The colony digs deep. Warmth below the scorched earth.
A cozy underground burrow housing three beavers.
Home is where the roots hold.
A compact underground burrow for one or two beavers.
